diffs.detail: the gateway error object is {code,message,path,type}; the official Error requires type,message,param,code and has no path
diffs.note: 有意对齐网关：fake 的 400 与已提交真实样本一致（漂移测试固定该结构）。官方 OpenAPI components.schemas.Error（https://github.com/openai/openai-openapi/blob/master/openapi.yaml，2026-11-08 核对）的 required 是 type/message/param/code，字段为 code/message/param/type，没有 path。构造的文档故障响应（invalid-key 401、forbidden 403、model-not-found 404、service-unavailable 503）改用官方 ErrorResponse；若要让样本派生的错误也严格对齐官方，需重新捕获样本并同步 policy 与漂移断言。

diffs.detail: the gateway 401 is bare text/plain unauthorized; the official 401 declares a JSON ErrorResponse or text/plain JSON-encoded error text
diffs.note: 有意对齐网关：未带 key 的 401 是已提交真实样本（text/plain "unauthorized"）。invalid-key 场景另给构造的官方 JSON ErrorResponse，依据 OpenAPI 的 401 响应声明（2026-11-08 核对）。

request_notes: 工具调用步骤（chat-tool-call、chat-tool-call-stream）：发给 fake 的请求在最后一条 user 消息末尾多了 fake 专用的工具标记 `[[fake:tool:lookup_note {"topic":"cube"}]]`，其余字节相同；官方模型自行决定调用工具，fake 只在标记出现时返回工具调用。
fake 的流式分片按官方 2026-10-29 实测的分片模式生成（角色、推理、正文或工具调用头与参数、结束分片）；已提交样本经 wirefixture 规范化后合并了中间分片，字段集合一致、中间分片的 null 类型不保留，所以漂移测试对 SSE 只比字段集合。

端点证据一节已离线重新生成（#536），加入 `POST /responses` 与 #536 新增的 constructed 形态；官方运行的步骤与差异仍是 2026-10-29 的那一次，没有新增官方请求。`/responses` 没有官方对齐步骤：脚本只有一个连接与一把 key，gpt-astra 在另一个连接上，它的真实证据来自 2026-11-20 的两次探测（脱敏样本见 testdata/responses-2026-11-20.sample.json），下一次真实一轮由 smoke-l5-chat-wire.py 与 smoke-l5-astra-tools.py 采集并回灌。

endpoints.note: the model list and the gateway's text/plain 401 are real samples; the invalid-key 401 ErrorResponse is a constructed-from-docs answer built from the OpenAPI ErrorResponse and the error-code guide (2026-11-08)

non-streaming, SSE streaming, tool_calls, reasoning_content and the model_required error are all real samples; the newest one is the 2026-11-23 chat capture (testdata/openai-v1-chat-2026-11-23.candidate.json, five completions of the same model and round), which is the template of every text completion: its usage reports prompt_tokens_details.text_tokens and it carries no system_fingerprint. The fault scenarios are constructed-from-docs answers (no committed sample) built from the OpenAPI and https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes (2026-11-08): invalid-key 401 ErrorResponse, forbidden 403 (text/plain JSON error text), model-not-found 404, service-unavailable 503 with Retry-After, quota-exceeded 429 with error.quota, and [[fake:stream-error]] ending a started stream with an error frame, [[fake:stream-cut]] ending a started stream cleanly before any finish_reason or [DONE] and [[fake:stream-plain]] answering a streaming request with the plain completion object (#509); the messages 400 follows the request schema's required/minItems 1. The gateway error envelope lacks the official param and carries path instead (see doc.go). Model constraints (#401, constraints.go): a request for gpt-astra or gpt-6.2-astra is judged by that model's rules and refused with a 400 invalid_request_error before any completion runs; the tools and temperature refusals are observed from the gateway's logs of 2026-11-20 (no committed sample), the reasoning_effort none refusal is constructed from the OpenAI documents checked the same day. Forms and refusals added by #536, all constructed (no committed sample has them; a real round settles each, and the Y items of the live-matrix are the ones to replace): a qwen-family model streams its usage on a last chunk with empty choices after the finish_reason chunk (the Model Studio OpenAI-compatible documents, read 2026-11-24; the deepseek shape, usage on the finish_reason chunk, stays the observed one); a picture is refused by the model's rules (qwen: height or width not larger than 32, the observed body of 2026-11-23; deepseek: no image input, the #253 wording) or by [[fake:image-refusal:KIND]] for the dimensions, size, format, count and unsupported kinds (size, format and count are constructed in the vendor's style); [[fake:dsml]] writes the matched tool calls as DSML in the reply text (the Schema's chat.dsml spelling) and [[fake:inline-image]] draws a picture in delta.images or message.images; [[fake:quota:CODE]] answers 429 with a quota code the chat connection's error_mapping declares, or rate_limit_exceeded (the official ErrorResponse envelope); deepseek (the family prefix) refuses a reasoning_effort outside low, high, max and the values the vendor maps onto them, and [[fake:strict-reasoning]] switches its reasoning_content rule to the broad reading of the vendor's guide (I28, unproven)

the Responses API (#401). Aligned to two real probes of the gateway on 2026-11-20 whose sanitized excerpt is testdata/responses-2026-11-20.sample.json. Observed and in the sample: the streamed tool call, text answer and two parallel calls (event order, field set, the event: line), a reasoning item at effort xhigh (its added and done events, the three different encrypted_content values of added, done and completed, no status, no summary event without a requested summary), an input_image part, the non-stream response, a tool schema with strict false and an optional property, a function_call without id or status under a rewritten call_id, the replay of the reasoning item without its id and a round without any reasoning item (both accepted), and the 400s byte for byte: temperature on gpt-astra, an unknown reasoning.effort, none and minimal (refused as unsupported values, naming the dated snapshot gpt-6.2-astra-2026-11-17), a function_call_output with no function_call and a function_call with no output (no code member). Kept constructed, not real, because the probes are not wirefixture candidates (the sample is hand-sanitized, and its provenance says which parts were completed from the non-stream response; the capture pipeline records a named SSE stream with event: lines and no [DONE] since #536, so the next real stream is recorded and back-filled by the pipeline instead) and because some behavior has no sample: response.incomplete, response.failed, the in-stream error event, response.refusal.delta, the reasoning summary events, a stream line over the bound, and the 400 for a reasoning item with no following item. Fake-only request conventions: the chat ones plus [[fake:reasoning]], [[fake:incomplete]], [[fake:failed]] and [[fake:unknown-event]]. The 2026-11-20 live window ended this route with the gateway's HTTP 429 daily model-group quota (testdata/openai-v1-quota-2026-11-20.candidate.json: error.code and error.type quota_exceeded plus the nested quota object), which is the envelope the quota-exceeded scenario answers and a test holds it to
